question: What is the typical range of a Local Area Network (LAN)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Up to 1 km**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Up to 1 km:** ✅ A Local Area Network (LAN) typically spans a small geographical area, such as a single building, campus, or a group of nearby buildings, with a maximum range of around 1 km.
